thread:
maria: quick sync — i think autoscaler/control-plane ownership for reserved-pool admission is still fuzzy. who owns rejecting a burst when operator is lagging? @dan @lee

dan: short answer: operator should own the immediate admission decision, control-plane only expresses intent. but we need a clear fallback policy for mismatches.

lee: +1. propose API change: AdmitRequest -> AdmitResponse { decision: enum {ACCEPT, SOFT_REJECT, HARD_REJECT}, reason: string, retry_after_secs: int? }

scheduler-bot: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/orch/pull/987 — includes proto sketch and a compatibility shim.

oliver: couple of operational edge cases: 1) preemptible-credit exhaustion, 2) operator restarts mid-admit, 3) transient API timeouts. for (1) i'd prefer operator return SOFT_REJECT with recommended `retry_after_secs` so callers can backoff to dedicated queue.

maria: agree on SOFT_REJECT pattern. also want to surface `admit_decision` + `reason` in traces/metrics so we can alert on unexpected HARD_REJECTs for healthy pools.

dan: about operator restarts: require an `idempotency_token` on AdmitRequest and treat duplicate tokens as noop if lease already granted. set short lease TTL (e.g., 30s) and have explicit `ConfirmLease(lease_id)` if longer-lived.

lee: good call. also add a compact acceptance audit log line: `ACCEPT lease_id=<uuid> pool=<pool> token=<idempotency>` so reconciliation can replay.

maria: rollout plan: tiny RFC -> feature-flagged operator + control-plane honor new responses. compatibility shim: if old unary bool path used, operator maps to ACCEPT/HARD_REJECT. gradual rollout: 10% of tenants for 48h then 50% then full.

oliver: i'll draft the RFC and add a small eval harness (simulate credit exhaustion + operator restart) to measure failure modes. aim to post by EOD.

dan: one more: add a liveness guard where control-plane will not consider a pool `available` unless operator has seen >=1 heartbeat since mesh boot — helps avoid false accepts during rolling updates.

maria: sweet. tagging eng-sre for observability checklist. any objections?

lee: none from me. :thumbsup:

oliver: no objections. i'll ping once RFC PR is up. :rocket:
